title: Compatibility of the two local completeness tests
statement: Let C be a small site, J its topology, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and choose derived categories of R-module sheaves and of module sheaves on every slice [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For K in D(R), U in C and f in R(U), the complete-element condition [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element], using sequential localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization] and restriction of a chosen complex representative [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction], is equivalent to vanishing of derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] from the sheafified sectionwise localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization] into the induced exact derived restriction of K [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction].

proof.text: For the exact slice-restriction functor F, its derived factorization at Q.objPreimage K identifies Q(F(Q.objPreimage K)) with D(F)(Q(Q.objPreimage K)). Apply D(F) to Q.objObjPreimageIso K to obtain the isomorphism with D(F)(K). These are the two restriction constructions.

proof.text: Apply derived internal Hom to the inverse opposite of the first isomorphism and the second isomorphism. The resulting isomorphism identifies the two tests, and isomorphic objects have equivalent IsZero predicates.

lean.statement:
theorem isRingedSiteCompleteElement_iff_localTest
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [h : ∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (R.over U)))]
    (K : ringedSiteDerived R) (U : C) (f : R.obj.obj (op U)) :
    let : ∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).over U)) := h
    IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f ↔
      IsZero ((derivedInternalHom (J.over U) (R.over U)).obj
        (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (ringedSectionLocalization (R.over U) (ringedSliceSection R U f))),
          (ringedDerivedRestriction R U).obj K))
